question: Which of the following is NOT one of the three principal ranges of the Lesser Himalayas?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Zaskar**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ** Himachal** is known as the **Lesser Himalayas or the Lower Himalayas, **with elevations ranging from 12000 to 15000 feet.
 
• The range stretches from **southeast Pakistan through Jammu and Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, western Uttar Pradesh, and Nepal.**
 
• **Himadri **(Great Himalayas or Inner Himalayas), **Himachal **(Lesser Himalayas), and** Shiwaliks** (Outer Himalayas) are the three parallel ranges of the Himalayas mountains.
 
• **Himadri (Great Himalayas or Inner Himalayas)-** This is the longest and most continuous Himalayan range.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Nag Tibba**, is the highest mountain in** Uttarakhand's lower Himalayan area and a Bugyal region. **
 
• It gives its name to the 'Nag Tibba Range,' which is the next-northernmost of the Himalayan folds.
 
• **Dhauladhar **is a mountain range that is part of the lower Himalayan chain.
 
• It rises to the north of Kangra
 
• **The Pir Panjal Range** is a series of mountains in the** Lesser Himalayan **area that runs from **east-southeast to west-northwest **over the Indian states of Himachal Pradesh, Jammu and Kashmir, and Pakistan-controlled Kashmir.
